Eric the car guy - Mechanic who has all kinds of car knowledge and shares it for free. Great for diy mechanics.

Scotty Kilmer - Another mechanic who imo is as good as it gets. Every tuesday I believe he does a ~30min live AMA about fixing car issues on youtube. From everything I've watched this guy knows everything about cars, really cool.

Primitive Pathways - A cool dude who's really into primitive technology. Makes his own traditional bows, hunts small game, even has an archery video of him shooting dragonflies.

Primitive Tim - A much lesser known youtuber with only ~2,000 subs, a younger semi-hippy guy who's driving across the United States in a van he bought shooting videos of all kinds of interesting things across the nation. Fun to get stoned and watch through.

LAHWF - One of the funnier youtubers, he does pranks on an above awkward level in such a good way, painfully awesome to watch.

Jorge Orellana - An amazing guitarist who does cover tutorials with tabs of the strokes and arctic monkeys along with many others. This guy's great and does tutorials how they're meant to be.

MAJER Crew - A group of young skaters who are really talented and always doing something new. They're involved with their viewers which I think is really cool.

Primitive Technology - If there's one channel you should check out it's this guy, he goes out into the Australian jungle and builds a house from complete scratch.
